rules.why: Hermes 0.21 and 0.22 paint a ready status row above the input composer after startup, session slash acknowledgements and completed turns. The elapsed-time row keeps repainting at rest, so quiet is not required. Startup and running turns replace ready; drafts occupy the composer. An empty composer shows one of the English placeholders in ui-tui/src/i18n/en/chrome.ts, after a named profile's prefix (ui-tui/src/lib/prompt.ts) or skin symbol (hermes_cli/skin_engine.py); an enabled battery read-out precedes ready. A draft typed identical to a placeholder still reads as empty.

any.regex: ^(?:[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,63} )?(?:❯|⚔|Ψ|◉|✦)(?: Ask me anything…| Try "/help" for commands)?$
^(?:[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,63} )?(?:❯|⚔|Ψ|◉|✦) Try "(?:explain this codebase|write a test for…|refactor the auth module|fix the lint errors|how does the config loader work\?)"$

rules.why: With display.tui_statusbar: bottom, Hermes paints the same ready row directly below the composer (ui-tui/src/components/appLayout.tsx).

any.regex: ^(?:[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,63} )?(?:❯|⚔|Ψ|◉|✦)(?: Ask me anything…| Try "/help" for commands)?$
^(?:[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,63} )?(?:❯|⚔|Ψ|◉|✦) Try "(?:explain this codebase|write a test for…|refactor the auth module|fix the lint errors|how does the config loader work\?)"$

rules.why: The classic Hermes screen (hermes without --tui, e.g. `hermes -p <profile> --model <model>`) paints no `─ ready │` status row (#35883). Idle shows the prompt row with one of the empty-composer placeholders from locales/en.yaml (placeholder.p01–p11, rotating) and the bottom bar's right segment reads `/ commands · @ files · ! shell`. A running turn replaces both with `type to redirect this turn · Tab queues it for after` and `enter interrupt · tab queue · ctrl+c stop`, so a busy classic screen keeps holding. A draft typed identical to a placeholder still reads as empty.

any.regex: ^(?:[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,63} )?(?:❯|⚔|Ψ|◉|✦) (?:Ask anything, or type / for commands…|Summarize what's in this folder|Draft a reply to the last email in my inbox)$
^(?:[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,63} )?(?:❯|⚔|Ψ|◉|✦) (?:Plan a feature, then build it step by step|Find and fix a failing test|Research this topic and write me a brief)$
^(?:[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,63} )?(?:❯|⚔|Ψ|◉|✦) (?:What changed in this repo recently\?|Turn these notes into a to-do list|Explain this error and how to fix it)$
^(?:[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,63} )?(?:❯|⚔|Ψ|◉|✦) (?:Set a reminder or schedule a recurring task|Type / to browse commands, or Ctrl\+P for the palette)$

rules.why: A readable screen without the ready footer and available composer is still starting, handling input, running a turn or showing a picker; a quiet process cannot prove otherwise. Translated locales, a custom branding.prompt_symbol and tui_statusbar: off leave no screen this file recognizes, so they hold until the wait times out.
